purpose: Publication-readiness gate checks evaluated by collections.readiness / workflow.gate. Evidence JSON maps check id -> true when satisfied.

checks.description: All cited sources ingested and hash-recorded in the corpus
Every material claim linked to evidence with locators
Citations resolve and quotations match sources (claims.quote-verify)
Overconfident-language pass complete (text.calibration) or waivers logged
Licenses/embargoes/attribution verified for all included material (security.rights)
Sensitive content scan clean or redacted (security.redact-scan)
QA score >= 95 with zero critical errors for each language edition
Named approver recorded in the decision log (workflow.gate)
Reproducible handoff archive built and reopen-tested (deliver.handoff + reopen)
